data_fields.name: effect_cost_curve
data_fields.donor_constant: per effect, e.g. Heal Health magnitude (20, 28)

best_idea: Derive a spell's pool cost and its shop price from its effects, using a per-effect cost curve, a caster-skill discount (110 - skill) / 400, a target multiplier and a floor of 5, so new spells are data rows and not code.
decision_why: Take the cost function and drop the spell-maker UI: Frankendom spells are fixed catalogue rows, the inscription flow is not needed for fast duels, and the coin price is one ledger entry charged by the server, not a client-side charge.
acceptance: In a duel the spell button shows a mana cost; the server refuses a cast when mana is below cost; a unit test asserts spellCost for three fixture spells (self, single-at-range, area-at-range) and checks the 5-point floor and the 320-gold no-component fudge before the skill factor.
